page.layout: One page of text, a dedication. Ornamental border at the top; the dedication lines are centred, the closing lines of the dedication follow below, with the signature at the foot right. A small red stamp-like mark near "Fines" is not printed text.

main_text.head: Viris Nobilissimis, Amplissimis, Prudentissimis, Dn. JOH. HENRICO HIRZELIO, Tribuno-plebis prudentissimo.
main_text.p: Dn. ANDREÆ SCHMIDIO, Comitatus Kyburgici Præfecto gravissimo.
Dn. JOH. HULDRICO ÆSCHERO, Baronatus Alto-Saxensis nuper Præfecto meritissimo.
Dn. JOH. JACOBO HULDRICO, Ecclesiæ Tigurinæ Antistiti Celeberrimo.
Dn. JOH. CONRADO HULDRICO, ejusdem Ecclesiæ Archidiacono dignissimo.
Dn. JOH. HENRICO HOSPINIANO, Ecclesiæ Reformatæ ad Fines, Pastori vigilantissimo.

Suo è sacri Baptismatis fonte susceptori, Cognatis, Patronis, Fautoribus eximiis, Avunculo, Patruo, omni officiorum & observantiæ genere colendis, honorandis, præsentem hanc Disputationem in grati animi, debitæque observantiæ σφεγγίδα consecratam esse vult

page.notes: The word "Pastori" in the red ink near "Fines" is a handwritten or stamped addition in colour, transcribed as shown. The Greek word after "observantiæ" is printed as σφεγγίδα in the scan and is uncertain [?]. The Greek word is rendered approximately; the printed form may differ. Dedication text is set in mixed roman and italic type.
